mentions.name: Tactus
mentions.description: A rhythm game in development for the NES, built around original pixel art and music, with a brief gameplay trailer released on its Steam page.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still chugging away at my NES rhythm game. Currently, in addition to climbing the content mountain (so, SO much pixel art and music needs to be made) I'm also slowly learning video editing workflows. I was able to put together a brief gameplay trailer this last week:
